description: Assert the element identified by ref or selector matches the given state flags (any of visible, enabled, disabled, checked, selected, expanded, pressed, focused, readonly, required, invalid, busy), evaluated atomically and polled until they hold or timeoutMs elapses. Returns: { ok, session_id, matched, state }. Errors: EXPECTATION_FAILED (state not reached within timeoutMs — details carry expected + the last observed actual state; retryable), REF_NOT_FOUND (stale ref; carries similar_refs), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (invalid selector, no state flags, or ref+selector both/neither).

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Max poll time in ms before EXPECTATION_FAILED (default 5000, clamped to 60000). 0 = check once.

name: electron_expect_state
title: Expect an element state
